title: Oven-Roasted Glazed Norwegian Burrata Stew
description: A charred, glassy-jelly Nordic stew that marries creamy burrata with sweet dates, roasted in a cataplana for a stunning date-night dish.
instructions: Wash and slice the fennel bulb into thin rings.
Slice the cherry tomatoes in half and set aside.
Wash the dates, pit them if needed, and cut into quarters.
Heat a pan over medium heat and drizzle in 2 tbsp olive oil.
Add the sliced fennel, minced garlic, and smoked paprika; sauté until the fennel is translucent.
Transfer the fennel mixture to a cataplana and add the cherry tomatoes, dates, and lemon juice.
Pour the red wine over the mixture and stir in sea salt and pepper.
Place the cataplana in the preheated oven and roast for 25 minutes to develop a caramelized glaze.
Remove the cataplana from the oven and gently fold in the burrata, letting it melt into the stew.
Spoon the stew onto a serving platter, sprinkle with fresh dill, drizzle with remaining olive oil, and serve immediately.
